summary: News Corp filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose daily ASX reporting of share repurchases under its existing $1 billion stock repurchase program. The filing is a routine administrative disclosure required by Australian exchange rules and does not announce a new special situation event. No terms, premiums, or structural changes are provided; the filing merely references prior authorization and forward-looking statements about potential repurchases. This is a routine current report of ongoing buyback activity rather than a material special situation.
